description: Verifier vectors for Tessarq Q2. Count keys are Qiskit's: classical bit 0 is the rightmost character. Integer scores and verdicts are exact; pass iff numerator * 1000000 >= threshold_ppm * denominator. Constraints are in reduced row echelon form over classical bits, pivoting on the lowest bit. Hellinger fidelity matches within `tolerance`.

cases.name: mirror-pass-at-threshold
mirror-fail-one-ppm-over
cases.why: One ppm above the score fails. No rounding before the comparison.

cases.name: mirror-score-floors
cases.why: 2/3 is 666666.67 ppm; the reported ppm floors to 666666 and the verdict is exact: 2*10^6 < 666667*3.

cases.name: mirror-stuck-at-zero
cases.why: A device that returns all-zeros cannot pass: the X layer moves the target off it.

cases.name: mirror-not-judged
cases.why: No threshold: the score is reported and no label is earned.

cases.name: ghz4-support
cases.why: 0001 breaks parity on bits {0,3}: the weakest constraint.

cases.name: ghz16-support-fail
clifford-partial-measurement
cases.why: q[1] is not measured and c[1] is never written, so c[1] must read 0.

cases.name: small-hellinger
error-truncated-histogram
error-key-width
error-multiple-registers
